title: Open World - Story Mode - Rough Game Play
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
Upfront, still needs polishing (especialy the people)!

An actual gameplay clip beyond the title screen. The story mode is open word, so everything is traversable:

* Run through any building (you have to find the exit before the fighting machine destroy the building with you in it)
* You can take trains to get destinations faster
* Escape with a bicycle from a chasing tripod
* Even get on a horse drawn carriage

The point you will have to get from point A to point B, how you get there and how you survive is 100% up to you.
